reason: I verified this and did not refute it. It is ops plumbing with no claim about the model or private score. It makes 0 Kaggle calls apart from 1-2 SELECTED reads, and every guard fails loudly. The hashes match the finding: readtime.sh befef6fb, msg44.py 233e5ba5, cardfix44.py af903431, and the real mk_card_1837.py is still a19e1bd6 with no <SP>/card_1837_* file written. I re-ran readtime.sh + pushtext44 with SELMOCK on all 11 fake logs and got exactly the claimed codes, L_lo/L_hi and Russian texts: T1 9.25/9.42; T1err F=1, L_hi 9.48; instail note on; T2 10.09/10.26; T3KEEP late; T5 -0.001; T6 9,4 h; T8 19:45:42Z; ADMIT -> T2 with L_hi 10.74; PENDING gives no push. Other cases I ran: the real poll.log (PENDING at 17:25:06Z) with two failed reads falls back to 12:37:31Z and prints the 'Не смог проверить' line; a ticked П2 gives b_old/b; N=1 gives case d. The decision-B cut points agree with the builder's own asserts: display >= 0.9595, 19:12:17Z = 10.2 h, 19:45:17Z = 10.75 h. The rank-line source is confirmed (plancheck R44-PC-01, Chrome 17:14:40Z, #154 of 4 003). cardfix works on T1 (ins-tail note) and T3KEEP. I found three gaps that do not refute it. (1) On T1/T2 with two failed SELECTED reads, pushtext44 line 1 is the 'Не смог проверить' line and the promotion/untick text is line 2, so 'send line 1' would drop the steps. (2) The worst-case wall time is 90+60+90 s plus the card build, which is over the Bash tool's default 120 s timeout. (3) A COMPLETE row with an empty score is read as T5 and msg44 crashes. That fails loudly, and poll.log has 0 such rows. Cosmetic: T8 prints '22:45 МСК ... позже края 22:45'. Side effect I must disclose: a test that was meant to write nothing rewrote the DRY files r44dry/card_1837_T1.txt (now carries an ins-tail note) and card_1837_T3KEEP.txt. The real card path is untouched.
fix: (a) Give each event's Bash call timeout: 300000. (b) Send every pushtext44 line except the 'CONTEXT FIRST' line, not just line 1; on T1/T2 with SELOK=0 that means the 'Не смог проверить' line followed by the promotion text. (c) If the READ line shows status=COMPLETE with disp=none, do not push or build the card; wait for the next poll. Alternatively, add the guard [ "$ST" = COMPLETE ] && [ -z "$DISP" ] && CODE=PENDING to readtime.sh. (d) Keep sourcing without a pipe, in the same call as pushtext44/cardcmd/cardfix, as command_blocks already say. (e) Do not treat r44dry/card_1837_*.txt as evidence; they are dry artefacts and two were rewritten during this check.
realistic_gain: None on the private or public score. It is an ops safeguard: it lowers the chance of a mis-coded or garbled push in the 18:17-19:47Z window before the 20:00Z tick, when an error could leave the wrong pair ticked (for example, a missed T1 promotion or a false T2). It costs 1-2 Kaggle calls per event.
